data.summary: AGV-3 is the least reliable AGV overall, with its highest failure concentration in shift A.

findings.claim: AGV-3 has the highest 90-day fault count of 84, ranking it as the single least reliable AGV in sf_fleet.agvs.
AGV-3 records 40 fault incidents in shift A, exceeding its 38 in shift B and 9 in shift N in sf_ops.incidents.
AGV-3 shift A shows 86 aborted tasks and 313 late tasks with 81649 total delay seconds, the highest aborted count in sf_fleet.agv_tasks.

data.recommendation: Schedule immediate preventive maintenance and inspection for AGV-3, prioritizing shift A where its fault incidents and aborted tasks are highest.
